description: Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Amendment to SLFRS 17 - Insurance of Contracts (Reserved)
reasoning: This gazette content contains amendments to SLFRS 17 (Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standard 17) - Insurance Contracts, which constitutes regulatory changes to accounting standards. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves modifications to statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks governing accounting practices, specifically under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995.
